ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Algae are directly eaten by, which among the below
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Dataset Open Question

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web. On the far left is a node labeled “Algae.” An arrow goes directly from “Algae” to the node labeled “Rotifer.” Other arrows continue from Rotifer toward Artemia and Mysid, and then toward Seahorse/Young Seahorse. Reasoning: In this food-web diagram, an arrow from a food source to an organism indicates that the receiving organism eats that source. Since the arrow starting at Algae points directly to Rotifer, the organism that directly eats algae is Rotifer.
